{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Vor'Teth''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] owned by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Rezzo]] and [[Drossh]]. On one of their heists, a disagreement erupted between them, and they accidentally set off one of the explosives on board, [[Death/Legends|killing]] both of them. The ''Vor'Teth'' was eventually salvaged and later sold as scrap.
